nodes.label: Steigenberger Hotel & Residence Doha Lockup
nodes.rationale: Standalone three-tier brand lockup asset, not a screen: serif STEIGENBERGER wordmark over letterspaced 'HOTEL & RESIDENCE' (#C0C5C7 vector paths) over 'DOHA' (#EDEAE4). Built for a dark ground - all fills are light greys and off-whites with no background plate. Newer than the A5-A7 exports and carries the 'HOTEL & RESIDENCE' descriptor where the screens render 'HOTEL DOHA', so it reads as the corrected or canonical lockup for the header slot.

nodes.label: Steigenberger Wordmark Raster Asset (486x242)
nodes.source_location: pattern0_45_4640 / pattern1_45_4640, images image0_45_4640 and image1_45_4640
nodes.rationale: The serif wordmark is not vector - it is a pair of 486x242 embedded PNGs (a luminance mask plus a colour plate, sha1 bddf6d1c0ab9 and 0d96b607b3e3) applied through SVG patterns behind a luminance mask. The identical byte-for-byte pair is embedded in A5, A6 and A7, making it the hard shared dependency that ties the lockup to every auth screen. Shipping the exported raster rather than re-tracing the serif preserves the licensed brand letterforms exactly.

edges.source_location: the lockup is the resolved element of the header band whose photographic backdrop is still a placeholder
